audit_metadata.title: OpenG2P + Fraud-Engine Audit — Sync State & Live Pipeline
audit_metadata.scope: Read-only investigation. No code changes, no fixes, no migrations, no commits were made.
audit_metadata.evidence_policy: Every claim cites a file path, line number, or literal command output. Items that could not be directly verified are listed under 'unverified'.

repo_state.git_status: On branch main / Your branch is up to date with 'origin/main'. / nothing to commit, working tree clean
repo_state.note: 'ls -d fraud-detection-engine/.git' returns 'No such file or directory'. Earlier assumptions of a nested repo were incorrect; git commands run from that subdirectory resolve to the parent repo.

critical_finding_app_data_not_on_github.summary: The entire app/data/ Python source package — including extractors.py, the live feature-extraction code path — is excluded from git and therefore absent from GitHub.

root_cause.explanation: A bare 'data/' pattern with no leading slash matches at ANY directory depth, so it excludes the Python source package app/data/ in addition to the intended ML data directory.

critical_finding_app_data_not_on_github.why_git_status_looks_clean: The files are IGNORED, not merely untracked. 'git status' therefore reports 'working tree clean', making the divergence silent and invisible in normal workflow.

file_counts.note: The 4 missing files are exactly the app/data/ package listed above.

critical_finding_app_data_not_on_github.additional_risk: These 4 files exist only on this machine. Combined with the previously-established absence of any db-data volume backup or snapshot mechanism, there is no recovery path if this machine is lost.

feature_extractor_status.note: Nothing in app/api invokes either FraudDatabase method. The stale header comment at postgres.py:8 ('Extraction des features ML -> deleguee a feature_extractor.py (source unique)') is inaccurate.
feature_extractor_status.irony: Git tracks the DEAD extractor (feature_extractor.py) and ignores the LIVE one (app/data/extractors.py).

fresh_clone_bootability.verdict: Boots, then fails on the first scoring request.
fresh_clone_bootability.reason: All app.data imports are lazy (inside function bodies), so module-level import of app.main succeeds and uvicorn starts. The failure occurs at first use of the scoring path.
import_chain: app/services/decision_service.py:8 — from app.data.extractors import BeneficiaryExtractor, RelationshipExtractor
fresh_clone_bootability.practical_impact: Health endpoints likely respond; scoring is entirely non-functional on a fresh clone of GitHub main.

metadata_json.note: openg2p_demo_metadata.json and paysim_metadata.json are NOT loaded by the serving app and were excluded from this audit per scope.

Reports weights Regles=0.05 / ML=0.95 / Graphe=-0.0, which differ entirely from metadata.json learned_weights (rule 0.2 / ml 0.55 / anomaly 0.05 / graph 0.2).
evaluation_report.corroborating_value: The report independently confirms the dead-feature findings: on 2026-06-04 it dropped 8 features as EMPTY (household_size, nb_children, nb_elderly, has_disabled, single_head, elderly_head, pmt_score, pmt_score_min). metadata.json (2026-07-27) nevertheless RE-INCLUDES all 8 in feature_columns.

pmt_fix_premise.question_status: The requested BEFORE/AFTER timestamp comparison is unanswerable as framed, since no fix exists to compare against.

feature_count_reconciliation.note: The 7 extra features are computed and passed but never reach the ML model; they serve the rule engine (rules TA001-TA005) only.
feature_count_reconciliation.dead_model_inputs_summary: Of the 28 features the model actually consumes, ~12 carry zero signal in production: household_size, nb_children, nb_elderly, has_disabled, single_head (hardcoded SQL literals), pmt_score, pmt_score_min (WHERE false), group_membership_count (source table empty), duplicate_national_id_count, income_ratio_to_national, household_size_deviation (never computed at serving time), and dependency_ratio (derives entirely from constants, always 0.0).

dataset_stats.discrepancy_note: The LaTeX report describes '9 scenarios'; the data contains 10 fraud scenarios plus 'legitimate'. duplicate_identity is severely under-represented at 13 rows (~0.26% of the dataset).
dataset_stats.consistency_note: legitimate scenario count (4399) differs by 58 from is_fraud==0 count (4341), indicating 58 rows labelled is_fraud=1 also carry scenario='legitimate' or a related labelling nuance — not investigated further in this pass.

key_findings.detail: The live extractor and its entire app/data/ package are gitignored by a stray bare 'data/' rule at fraud-detection-engine/.gitignore:31. A fresh clone starts but raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.data' on the first scoring call.
key_findings.compounding_risk: These 4 files exist only on this machine, and no db-data volume backup or snapshot mechanism exists.

key_findings.finding: No PMT fix was ever applied.
key_findings.detail: extractors.py:59 still contains 'WHERE false'; PERCENT_RANK appears nowhere in the repository. Every beneficiary's pmt_score and pmt_score_min are hardcoded to 0.5 in the live scoring path.

key_findings.finding: evaluation_report.txt does not describe the deployed model.
key_findings.detail: The report (dated 2026-06-04, AUC 0.8578) evaluates a single calibrated XGBoost with weights 0.05/0.95/-0.0, whereas the served model (metadata.json, 2026-07-27) is a stacking_logreg ensemble with weights 0.2/0.55/0.05/0.2. No evaluation artifact exists on disk for the deployed ensemble.

key_findings.finding: Roughly 12 of the model's 28 input features carry zero signal in production.
key_findings.detail: Five demographic features are hardcoded SQL literals, two PMT features are constant, three calibration/identity features are never computed at serving time, one source table is empty, and dependency_ratio derives entirely from constants.
